sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 original model card
sources.evidence: Identifies original first-generation R1, released weights under MIT, nominal 671B total and 37B active, 128K context, text generation and reasoning; points to DeepSeek-V3 for architecture.

sources.title: DeepSeek API change log
sources.evidence: January 20, 2025 entry introduces R1 as deepseek-reasoner. March 24 concerns V3-0324, not R1. May 28 upgrades the reasoner alias to R1-0528 and introduces JSON/function-calling support. Subsequent entries retarget that alias again.

sources.title: Original R1 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM; 61 main layers, one next-token-prediction layer, 256 routed experts with eight selected, one shared expert, FP8 block quantization, text vocabulary and max_position_embeddings 163840.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 technical report, revised January 2026
sources.evidence: Section 6 explicitly says the original DeepSeek-R1 cannot use search/calculator tools. Appendix A identifies the V3-Base MoE foundation; Appendix B describes MTP speculative decoding during RL. This later report still concerns original R1, not the separate 0528 checkpoint.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 architecture weight-file documentation
sources.evidence: Architecture guide linked by the R1 card defines main layers 0–60 and MTP layer 61. MTP embedding/output head share main-model parameters; it distinguishes nominal main 671B and unique MTP 11.5B. weight_scale_inv tensors are FP8 dequantization metadata.

sources.title: R1 checkpoint index and the 163 referenced shard headers
sources.evidence: All 91,991 indexed tensor names matched bounded HTTP-range reads of all 163 safetensors headers. Excluding scale tensors: main 671,026,419,200 and MTP 13,463,426,304 parameter-shaped slots. Their 684,489,845,504 sum includes separately stored MTP embedding/head entries, so it is not an exact unique learned total.

sources.title: Original R1 repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository created January 20, 2025; audited revision 56d4cbbb4d29f4355bab4b9a39ccb717a14ad5ad. Its safetensors aggregate 684,489,845,504 agrees with the header sum but does not resolve logical parameter sharing.

sources.title: Separate DeepSeek-R1-0528 model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly presents an upgraded version and separate original-R1 versus R1-0528 evaluation columns. Function-calling results appear only for 0528. This card is used to disambiguate identity, not transfer upgraded capabilities.

sources.title: Original R1 January 20 release
sources.evidence: Historical announcement with trailing slash confirms January 20 release, MIT licensing, six distillations and R1 reasoner alias.

sources.title: model.norm.weight bounded tensor comparison
sources.evidence: Fetched only the complete 14336-byte BF16 normalization tensor after its header. Main and MTP norms differ at7165 of7168 scalar positions, so this MTP norm is distinct and retained.

sources.title: model.layers.61.shared_head.norm.weight bounded tensor comparison
sources.evidence: Fetched only the complete 14336-byte BF16 normalization tensor after its header. Main and MTP norms differ at7165 of7168 scalar positions, so this MTP norm is distinct and retained.

name.note: Exact original checkpoint name; excludes R1-Zero, distillations and R1-0528.

family.note: Retained catalog grouping for DeepSeek reasoning models; source describes the R1 reasoning family, not this literal internal taxonomy key.

release_date.note: Official changelog date, independently consistent with repository creation; not the January 22 paper submission or May 28 upgrade.

open_weights.note: Public original checkpoint and all indexed weight shards exist.

license.note: Original R1 weights and code are MIT; distilled-model base licenses are separate.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique logical count:671.0264192B main +11.610068224B unique MTP =682.636487424B. All163 headers were reconciled, FP8 scales excluded, and documented shared embedding/head copies deducted once. Full small norm comparison proves the MTP norm differs from main norm and must remain counted. The original671B headline is main-only.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-rounded active MAIN-model parameters per token. Does not include a separate MTP speculative-decoding phase. No falsely precise active total is inferred from stored tensors.

architecture.note: V3-derived decoder Transformer with MLA, 256 routed experts and eight routed experts selected per token, plus a shared expert.

context_window.note: Retains catalog normalization of the advertised 128K context. This is a nominal advertised limit, not an exact 131072 claim. Configuration max_position_embeddings 163840 is a different architectural setting and is not substituted for documented support.

modalities.note: Text causal language model; exact checkpoint has token embeddings and no vision/audio encoder.

reasoning.note: Dedicated first-generation R1 reasoning model with reasoning-oriented post-training.

tool_call.note: Later first-party report explicitly identifies tool use as unsupported for original R1. May 28 function-calling support belongs to R1-0528; current deepseek-reasoner alias capabilities cannot be back-projected.

description.value: Original DeepSeek-R1 open-weight reasoning model, post-trained from DeepSeek-V3-Base for mathematics, coding and reasoning.
description.note: Replaces subjective classic/transparent wording with supported identity and training lineage.

patch.description: Original DeepSeek-R1 open-weight reasoning model, post-trained from DeepSeek-V3-Base for mathematics, coding and reasoning.
patch.notes: Original January 2025 R1 checkpoint, distinct from R1-0528 and the changing deepseek-reasoner API alias. Complete unique logical count is 682.636487424B: 671.0264192B main plus 11.610068224B MTP. FP8 scales and documented shared embedding/output-head copies are excluded. The MTP final norm differs from the main norm and is retained. Nominal 37B active refers to main inference. Advertised context is 128K; configured positions are 163840. Native tool calling is unsupported for this original version.

checkpoint_audit.note: All tensor headers establish shapes. The architecture guide explicitly ties MTP embedding/output-head matrices to the main model. Subsequent complete BF16 norm comparisons resolve the remaining7168-entry ambiguity:7165values differ, so the MTP norm is distinct. Full total deducts only documented embedding/head copies; FP8 scales are excluded. No whole shard downloaded.

access_limitations: Historical release announcement is accessible at the trailing-slash news250120 URL; the slashless path can fall back to current documentation.
summary: All14fields audited for original January2025 R1. Follow-up bounded norm comparison resolves unique total as682.636487424B including MTP, excluding scales/shared matrix copies. Nominal37B main active, MIT, MoE, advertised128K, text/reasoning and explicitly unsupported native tools remain verified.
